notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This studio surface does not exist yet.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: Refresh the studio and try again.

workspace.title: Spatial Canvas
workspace.description: A quiet space for physical creation in virtual air. Control your canvas naturally using modern hand-tracking camera interactions.

release.title: Release Pinch
release.desc: Drop ink to commit spatial shape

idle.title: Start the camera canvas
idle.desc: Grant front-camera access to mirror your hand and begin drawing in the air.

loading.title: Preparing hand tracking
loading.desc: Loading the camera and browser hand-landmark model.

denied.title: Camera permission is blocked
denied.desc: Allow camera access in the browser, then return here to start the studio.

unsupported.title: Camera is not supported
unsupported.desc: This browser does not expose camera access. Try a modern mobile or desktop browser.

error.title: Camera could not start
error.desc: Close other apps using the camera, then try again.

guidance.far: Move your hand closer to the camera.

onboarding.title: Welcome to your calm creative studio.
onboarding.description: Using your front-facing camera or standard computer webcam, paint and manipulate objects organically in 2D spatial coordinates. No gloves, controllers, or setups required.

draw.title: Draw Stroke
draw.desc: Pinch your thumb and index finger together to paint fine spatial lines.

grab.title: Grab & Drag
grab.desc: Make a fist next to any static stroke to pick up and move it elsewhere.

release.title: Release Shape
release.desc: Open your hand fully to place the shape firmly on your canvas.

settings.title: Studio Settings
settings.smoothingDesc: Reduces hand jittering via weighted exponential moving average filtering.
settings.soundDesc: Play soft clay scraping sounds when drawing paths.
settings.deadzoneDesc: Pinch detection proximity margin in camera-view pixels.
settings.grabDesc: How close a fist must be to an existing shape before it can move it.
settings.footer: Spatial Gesture Canvas — Built with local machine learning front-end models.
